title: Typing in chat
description: Typing, edits, deletion and paste animate in real Minecraft chat.

title: Commands keep their colours
description: Command syntax colours are preserved while typing and completing with Tab.

title: Appear and remove styles
description: Pop, Scramble, Wave and Drop paired with removal effects. Version 1.1 has 17 appearance effects and 10 removal effects.

title: New animation styles — 1.1
description: Slide Right, Zoom Out, Flip, Swing, Roll and Spiral, with new removal effects.

title: A cursor that glides
description: Custom caret shape, colour and thickness, with independent smooth movement speed.

title: Signs and hanging signs
description: Real vanilla sign editors with animated text, deletion and a smooth cursor across lines.

title: Three settings tabs — 1.1
description: Animations, Cursor and Where to animate with a live preview and Demo.

title: In the world
description: Animated text in Minecraft chat. The mod runs only on the client.

title: Animation settings — 1.1
description: Separate appearance and removal effects, duration, intensity and text movement settings.

title: Настройки анимаций — 1.1
description: Русский интерфейс с живым предпросмотром, демо и тремя вкладками настроек.

title: Options button
description: Open Typing Animation directly from Minecraft Options.

title: Ordinary sign editor
description: Animated text across four lines while editing an ordinary sign.

title: Hanging sign editor
description: Animated coloured and glowing text while editing a hanging sign.

title: Cursor settings
description: Choose a shape, colour, thickness and independent glide speed.

title: Where animations run
description: Separate controls for chat, other fields, multiline input and signs, plus focus behaviour.
